<!--
The live report runner.

This is the opt-in path: it calls a model, so it needs credentials and the
mcp-repl binary, and it is never part of the default build. A clean clone still
produces every talk artifact from the seeded generator with neither. deploy.R
publishes it to Posit Connect with those two things supplied.

What it does, in order: resolve the sandboxed REPL, write the snapshot to a
scratch directory, give the model a REPL to look around and a form to hand in
its answer, then deliver what it handed in -- labelled as a model's work,
submitted for review.

The evidence behind each headline is a table the model saved from its own REPL
session. The runner checks that it is a well-formed table and takes the model's
code as its account of how the table was made. Nothing is re-run. That is the
same bargain the reference implementation strikes, and the reviewer, not the
runner, is the check on whether a finding holds up.
-->

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

# A Connect bundle has no .git or .Rproj for here() to find; anchor on this file.
here::i_am("weekly-report.Rmd")

library(dplyr)
library(ellmer)
library(mcptools)

source(here::here("prep", "build_cohort.R"))
source(here::here("R", "live_report.R"))
source(here::here("R", "token_budget.R"))
source(here::here("R", "email_preview.R"))
```

```{r check-repl}
# Resolve the binary rather than assuming PATH. deploy.R bundles a Linux build
# at bin/mcp-repl for Connect; locally that file is the wrong architecture, so
# it is used only if it actually runs. The installer puts a local copy in
# ~/.local/bin, which an Rmd render often does not inherit.
repl_binary <- local({
  bundled <- here::here("bin", "mcp-repl")
  if (file.exists(bundled)) {
    if (file.access(bundled, mode = 1L) != 0L) Sys.chmod(bundled, "0755")
    runs <- suppressWarnings(system2(bundled, "--help", stdout = FALSE, stderr = FALSE))
    if (identical(runs, 0L)) return(bundled)
  }
  found <- Sys.which("mcp-repl")[[1]]
  if (nzchar(found)) return(found)
  fallback <- path.expand("~/.local/bin/mcp-repl")
  if (file.exists(fallback)) return(fallback)
  stop(
    "mcp-repl not found. Install it with:\n",
    "  curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/posit-dev/mcp-repl/main/scripts/install.sh | sh",
    call. = FALSE
  )
})
```

```{r config}
# Provider and model come from INBOX_CHAT_PROVIDER and INBOX_CHAT_MODEL (see
# config.example.R). Any provider ellmer knows will do; the API key belongs in
# ~/.Renviron.
PROVIDER <- inbox_provider()$provider
MODEL <- inbox_provider()$model

N_CANDIDATES <- 8L   # brainstormed before choosing
N_HEADLINES <- 3L    # carried into the email

# A REPL on a schedule is an open-ended loop with a bill attached. The notice
# gives the model a chance to finish cleanly; the caps stop it regardless.
# R/token_budget.R is where both are enforced.
budget <- token_budget(input_cap = 1e6, output_cap = 1e5, warn_at = 0.8)

OUTPUT_DIR <- inbox_artifact_path("live")
dir.create(OUTPUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r load-data}
# The model sees funnel_snapshot() and nothing else. funnel_cohort carries
# won_eventually, and a report built on hindsight would be worthless as a
# demonstration even when the arithmetic checked out.
snapshot <- funnel_snapshot(read_funnel_cohort())

# One directory, one file. The REPL is spawned with this as its working
# directory, so the workspace it may write to is this and not the repository,
# and the tables it saves land where the runner can read them back.
scratch <- file.path(tempdir(), paste0("inbox-repl-", Sys.getpid()))
dir.create(scratch, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
saveRDS(snapshot, file.path(scratch, "snapshot.rds"))

repl_config <- file.path(scratch, "mcp-repl.json")
jsonlite::write_json(list(mcpServers = list(`r-repl` = list(
  command = repl_binary,
  args = list(
    "--interpreter", "r",
    "--sandbox", "workspace-write",
    "--add-writable-root", scratch
  )
))), repl_config, auto_unbox = TRUE, pretty = TRUE)
```

```{r tools}
# Two classes of capability, as the talk describes them: a REPL to look around,
# and a form to hand in the answer. Everything else the model gets is context.
staging <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
staging$candidates <- NULL
staging$headlines <- vector("list", N_HEADLINES)
staging$submitted <- FALSE

submit_candidates <- ellmer::tool(
  function(candidates) {
    if (length(candidates) < N_HEADLINES) {
      stop("Offer at least ", N_HEADLINES, " candidates before choosing.", call. = FALSE)
    }
    staging$candidates <- candidates
    paste0("Recorded ", length(candidates), " candidates. Now develop ",
      N_HEADLINES, " of them, one call each.")
  },
  description = paste(
    "Record the shortlist of things worth investigating, before developing any",
    "of them. Call once."
  ),
  arguments = list(candidates = ellmer::type_array(
    items = ellmer::type_string("A one-line description of a question worth asking.")
  )),
  name = "submit_candidates"
)

submit_headline <- ellmer::tool(
  function(slot, title, finding, suggested_action, metric_definition, caveat,
           evidence_file, reproducible_code) {
    if (is.null(staging$candidates)) {
      stop("Record candidates before developing headlines.", call. = FALSE)
    }
    if (slot < 1 || slot > N_HEADLINES) {
      stop("Slot must be between 1 and ", N_HEADLINES, ".", call. = FALSE)
    }

    insight <- list(
      title = title, finding = finding, suggested_action = suggested_action,
      metric_definition = metric_definition, caveat = caveat,
      # The table the model saved from the REPL, read back from the directory
      # the REPL was spawned in. The model never retypes its numbers.
      evidence = read_live_evidence(scratch, evidence_file),
      reproducible_code = reproducible_code
    )

    # Checked here rather than at the end, so the model is told immediately
    # and can fix one headline instead of losing the whole run.
    validate_live_insight(insight)
    staging$headlines[[slot]] <- insight
    paste0("Headline ", slot, " accepted with ",
      length(insight$evidence$rows), " evidence rows.")
  },
  description = paste(
    "Hand in one developed headline. Save its evidence table in the working",
    "directory with saveRDS() first, then pass the file name."
  ),
  arguments = list(
    slot = ellmer::type_integer("Which headline slot, 1-based."),
    title = ellmer::type_string("Short headline."),
    finding = ellmer::type_string("What the evidence shows, in one or two sentences."),
    suggested_action = ellmer::type_string("A proportionate next step."),
    metric_definition = ellmer::type_string("Exactly how the metric is computed."),
    caveat = ellmer::type_string("What this evidence cannot establish."),
    evidence_file = ellmer::type_string(paste(
      "File name of the saved table, e.g. headline_1.rds: one data frame, first",
      "column the row labels, every other column numeric, at most",
      LIVE_EVIDENCE_MAX_ROWS, "rows."
    )),
    reproducible_code = ellmer::type_string(
      "The R code that produced that exact table from `snapshot`."
    )
  ),
  name = "submit_headline"
)

submit_report <- ellmer::tool(
  function() {
    missing <- which(vapply(staging$headlines, is.null, logical(1)))
    if (length(missing)) {
      stop("Headline slots still empty: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "), ".", call. = FALSE)
    }
    staging$submitted <- TRUE
    "Report submitted."
  },
  description = "Call once all headline slots are filled.",
  arguments = list(),
  name = "submit_report"
)
```

```{r system-prompt}
system_prompt <- paste(
  "You write a weekly funnel report for ChickenCloud, a B2B SaaS company.",
  "",
  "You have a sandboxed R session. `snapshot.rds` in the working directory is a",
  "point-in-time view of the lead funnel: one row per lead, with entry and stage",
  "dates, durations, and dimensions assigned at entry. Load it with",
  "`snapshot <- readRDS(\"snapshot.rds\")`.",
  "",
  "WORKFLOW",
  paste0("1. Explore. 2. Call submit_candidates with at least ", N_CANDIDATES,
    " questions worth asking. 3. Develop the ", N_HEADLINES,
    " best with submit_headline, one call each. 4. Call submit_report."),
  "",
  "WHAT THE DATA WILL DO TO YOU IF YOU ARE CARELESS",
  "- Recent cohorts have had less time to convert. Comparing conversion across",
  "  cohorts of different ages shows a decline that is only delay. Compare over",
  "  an equal window from entry, or say the newest cohort is incomplete.",
  "- late_industry, late_deal_value and late_competitor are captured partway",
  "  down the funnel and are blank for leads that stopped earlier. Grouping a",
  "  full-funnel denominator by one of them silently changes the denominator.",
  "- campaigns holds several values per lead. Splitting it before grouping",
  "  counts a lead once per campaign. Report touches, not leads.",
  "- Some stage dates were backfilled; the use_for_time_* flags say which are",
  "  trustworthy for durations. A duration from a guessed date is fiction.",
  "- won_as_of is what was known at the cutoff. There is no hindsight here and",
  "  you should not imply any.",
  "",
  "EVIDENCE",
  "Every headline rests on one small table. Compute it in the R session, then",
  "save it in the working directory: `saveRDS(table, \"headline_1.rds\")`. One",
  "data frame; the first column labels the rows, every other column is a",
  paste0("number, and at most ", LIVE_EVIDENCE_MAX_ROWS, " rows. Pass the file name as evidence_file, and"),
  "pass the code that produced that exact table from `snapshot` as",
  "reproducible_code. The table and the code go into the email as you hand them",
  "in, and a reader will run the code, so report only what you computed.",
  "",
  "Prefer a finding with a decision attached to one that is merely true.",
  sep = "\n"
)
```

```{r generate, include = FALSE}
report <- NULL
failure <- NULL

result <- try({
  # Spawn the REPL from the scratch directory so that its writable workspace is
  # that directory rather than wherever this document happens to be rendered.
  repl_tools <- withr::with_dir(scratch, mcptools::mcp_tools(config = repl_config))
  if (!length(repl_tools)) stop("The REPL exposed no tools.", call. = FALSE)

  chat <- ellmer::chat(
    paste0(PROVIDER, "/", MODEL), system_prompt = system_prompt, echo = "none"
  )

  # Every tool, the REPL's included, is wrapped so the budget notice can reach
  # the model. A tool result is the only channel back to it mid-run; the
  # callback below can watch the meter but cannot change what the model sees.
  chat$set_tools(lapply(
    c(repl_tools, list(submit_candidates, submit_headline, submit_report)),
    deliver_budget_notice, budget = budget
  ))
  chat$on_tool_result(function(result) {
    check_token_budget(budget, chat$get_tokens())
  })

  chat$chat(paste0(
    "Produce this week's report. Explore the snapshot, shortlist at least ",
    N_CANDIDATES, " questions, then develop the ", N_HEADLINES, " best."
  ))

  if (!staging$submitted) {
    stop("The model stopped without calling submit_report.", call. = FALSE)
  }

  report <- new_live_report(
    insights = staging$headlines, snapshot = snapshot,
    provider = PROVIDER, model = MODEL
  )
}, silent = TRUE)

if (inherits(result, "try-error")) failure <- conditionMessage(attr(result, "condition"))
```

```{r output}
failure_page <- function(message) {
  tags <- htmltools::tags
  tags$html(lang = "en",
    tags$head(
      tags$meta(charset = "utf-8"),
      tags$title("No report this run"),
      tags$style(htmltools::HTML(inbox_preview_css()))
    ),
    tags$body(tags$div(class = "sheet",
      tags$h1("No report this run"),
      tags$p("Generation failed and nothing was written."),
      tags$pre(.noWS = "inside", tags$code(.noWS = "inside", message))
    ))
  )
}

# doRenderTags, not as.character: the latter hoists <head> out of the document
# the way Shiny wants, which would leave the email and the page without CSS.
if (is.null(failure)) {
  page <- htmltools::doRenderTags(live_email_html(report, snapshot))
  write_live_report(report, file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "weekly_report_live.json"))
  write_live_email_preview(report, snapshot, file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "weekly-email-live.html"))
  message("Wrote ", length(report$insights), " headlines to ", OUTPUT_DIR)

  # On Connect this is the email that goes out; anywhere else the metadata is
  # inert and the preview file is the deliverable.
  rmarkdown::output_metadata$set(
    rsc_email_subject = paste0(
      INBOX_COMPANY, " weekly insights, data as of ", require_snapshot(snapshot)
    ),
    rsc_email_body_html = page
  )
} else {
  # No partial email, and on Connect no email at all. A run that did not finish
  # has nothing that should reach an inbox.
  rmarkdown::output_metadata$set(rsc_email_suppress_scheduled = TRUE)
  page <- htmltools::doRenderTags(failure_page(failure))
}

# A raw block passes through pandoc untouched, so with the bare template the
# rendered document is exactly this HTML.
knitr::raw_html(page)
```

```{r cleanup, include = FALSE}
unlink(scratch, recursive = TRUE)
```
